verdict.rationale: Stripe provides several autonomous background processes (recurring billing, smart retries/revenue recovery, Radar fraud scoring, webhooks) that run without ongoing intervention, and it offers agent-specific tooling (MCP server, CLI, agents.md) letting AI agents interact with the API. However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose automation/workflow builder for AI-native users to configure arbitrary autonomous tasks—these are pre-built, domain-specific automations rather than a flexible agentic automation platform.
